title: ChatGPT 新手入门：注册、使用与进阶技巧
summary: 从零开始学会使用 ChatGPT，掌握基础对话、文件上传与联网搜索，快速上手这个全球最流行的 AI 助手。
titleEn: ChatGPT Beginner's Guide: Registration, Usage, and Advanced Tips
summaryEn: Learn to use ChatGPT from scratch, master basic conversations, file uploads, and web search, and quickly get started with the world's most popular AI assistant.

title: Prompt 提示词技巧：让 AI 更懂你
summary: 同样的 AI，不同的提示词效果天差地别。掌握角色设定、结构化指令与思维链，让回答质量翻倍。
titleEn: Prompt Tips: Make AI Understand You Better
summaryEn: The same AI, different prompts can lead to vastly different results. Master role-setting, structured instructions, and chain-of-thought to double the quality of responses.

title: AI 绘画入门：用 Midjourney 生成第一张图
summary: 从注册到生成，一步步教你用 Midjourney 画出满意的图片，并理解风格、参数与常用提示词套路。
titleEn: AI Drawing Beginner's Guide: Generate Your First Image with Midjourney
summaryEn: From registration to generation, step by step learn to use Midjourney to create satisfying images, and understand styles, parameters, and common prompt patterns.

title: AI 编程入门：用 Cursor 提升开发效率

titleEn: Getting Started with AI Programming: Boost Development Efficiency with Cursor
summaryEn: Learn the core concepts of AI programming and use Cursor for code completion, conversational code editing, and multi-file refactoring, making AI your pair programming partner.

title: AI 视频生成入门：Sora 与可灵怎么用

summaryEn: Understand the working principles of text-to-video, master the usage and prompt writing of tools like Sora and Kling, and generate your first AI video.

title: AI 搜索实战：Perplexity 与秘塔的高效用法
summary: 告别关键词搜索，学会用 AI 搜索直接获得带来源的答案，掌握深度研究、学术搜索与溯源技巧。
titleEn: AI Search in Practice: Efficient Use of Perplexity and Metaso
summaryEn: Say goodbye to keyword search and learn to use AI search to get answers with sources directly, mastering deep research, academic search, and source tracing techniques.

title: AI 音乐创作：用 Suno 写一首歌
summary: 不需要会乐理，输入一句描述或一段歌词，让 Suno 为你生成完整的歌曲，并学会控制风格与结构。

summaryEn: No music theory or instruments needed. Enter a description or lyrics, and let Suno generate a complete song for you, while learning to control style and structure.

title: AI 办公提效：用 AI 做 PPT、写文档

summaryEn: Delegate repetitive documents, PPTs, and meeting minutes to AI, and master efficient usage of tools like Notion AI, WPS AI, and Gamma.

title: AI Agent 智能体入门：让 AI 帮你干活
summary: 搞懂智能体到底是什么、和普通 AI 聊天的区别，并亲手搭一个能自动干活的 AI 助手。

summaryEn: Understand what AI agents are, how they differ from regular chatbots, and build your own agent that gets work done automatically.

title: DeepSeek 使用指南：免费好用的国产 AI

title: 用 AI 做副业：5 个真实赚钱方向

summaryEn: Skip the hype. Five realistic AI side-hustle directions that amplify your existing skills, with entry barriers, methods, and pitfalls.
